title: The Riddle of the Purple Emperor
description: A complex mystery involving the disappearance of Lady Margaret Cheyne, the murder of her aunt Miss Cheyne, and the theft of the famed Purple Emperor jewel. The narrative unfolds through a series of clues, hidden identities, and intricate plots set in various locations around London and Hampton.
intro_narrative: It was nearly half-past five on a wild March afternoon, and Charing Cross Station was bustling with the arrival of a boat-train from the continent. Among the crowd was Hamilton Cleek, waiting for Ailsa Lorne, who was returning with Lady Margaret Cheyne, a young girl fresh from a convent in Paris. Cleek's drive to Cheyne Court with Lady Margaret would unravel a mystery that involved murder, deception, and the famed Purple Emperor jewel.

required_evidence: Gold lace scarf fragment found in the dead man's hand
Fingerprints matching those of Sam Blake on the murder weapon
Prussic acid pellet found in the dead man's mouth
Seal ring marks on the victim's throat
required_motive: Theft of the Purple Emperor jewel
Control over Lady Margaret Cheyne's inheritance
